Yes but they've still gone because of AI. Whether or not they should have been there in the first place, does it matter? They have been replaced. Some people have explicitly said it's because of AI, like the cloudflare ceo.

Look up 'unit cost Dominance' once AI + verifier is cheaper than you at your job. You will be replaced.  That's just basic economics.

author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

replies.text:
Don't trust the management BS. They are just blaming AI for their own mistakes.

The nature of the job will be different, just like spreadsheets didn't replace accountants, in fact we got a lot more accountants.  Lumber jacks are not replaced by chainsaws

author.name: Ben Luong
author.headline: Advanced Google Ads and conversion tracking | Founder, Fire Pixel | GA4, GTM, n8n, BigQuery | 20+ years in performance marketing

replies.text:
"Management is lying" is not the escape hatch you think it is.

For public companies, claiming AI drove layoffs is a material productivity claim. Either AI is replacing labour, or executives are misleading markets about why headcount is falling.

One is technological displacement.

The other is potentially securities-fraud / jail-time territory.
